headerDisplay: Control your Sony projector over IP using Sony's ADCP protocol. Exposes a HomeKit Television tile with inputs; picture/HDR controls are separate from input selection.

ip.title: Projector IP Address
ip.description: Set a DHCP reservation for reliability.

useAuth.title: Requires Authentication
useAuth.description: Enable only if ADCP ▶︎ Requires Authentication is ON in the projector web UI.

password.title: ADCP Password
password.description: Used to compute the SHA-256 response to the projector's nonce when ADCP authentication is enabled.

timeout.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout.description: How long to wait for projector replies before failing.

inputs.title: Input Sources
inputs.description: Define inputs to appear in the Home app. Each input must have a unique Identifier.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: Numeric ID used by HomeKit (1..50). Must be unique across inputs.

adcp.title: ADCP Source Key
adcp.description: ADCP input token (e.g., hdmi1, hdmi2). If 'Custom', replace with the exact ADCP value supported by your model.

enableBlankScreen.title: Enable Blank Screen Switch
enableBlankScreen.description: Adds a switch to toggle video mute (blank screen).

enableBrightness.title: Enable Brightness Slider
enableBrightness.description: Adds a Lightbulb service with a Brightness slider (0–100).

enableContrast.title: Enable Contrast Slider
enableContrast.description: Adds a Lightbulb service with a Contrast slider (0–100).

enablePictureModes.title: Enable Picture Mode Switches
enablePictureModes.description: Adds exclusive switches for each picture mode (Cinema, Reference, Game, etc.).

enableHdrSelector.title: Enable HDR Mode Selector
enableHdrSelector.description: Adds HDR controls. In **UI Layout → Option 3 (Legacy Mixed List)** HDR modes appear in the TV Inputs list; otherwise they appear as separate switches.

enableTestPatterns.title: Enable Test Patterns (Advanced)
enableTestPatterns.description: Expose test patterns as virtual inputs (e.g., Grid, Color Bars). Hidden by default.

enableLampHoursSensor.title: Enable Lamp/Laser Hours Sensor
enableLampHoursSensor.description: Adds a read-only sensor that displays total hours (shown as lux value).

enableErrorSensor.title: Enable Error Status Sensor
enableErrorSensor.description: Adds a contact sensor that opens when the projector reports an error.

uiLayout.title: HomeKit UI Layout
uiLayout.description: inputs_only: TV selector shows only HDMI inputs (advanced controls become dedicated switches). mixed_virtual: HDMI inputs + virtual Picture/HDR/Test Pattern entries are combined in the TV input list.

pictureModes.title: Picture Modes
pictureModes.description: Picture Mode options. Use string codes for VPL-XW5000 (e.g., 'reference', 'cinema_film_1').

hdrModes.title: HDR Modes
hdrModes.description: HDR Mode options. Use string codes for VPL-XW5000 (e.g., 'auto', 'off', 'hdr10', 'hlg').

testPatterns.title: Test Patterns (Advanced)
testPatterns.description: Test pattern options. Use string codes for VPL-XW5000.

staticModel.title: Static Model (optional)
staticModel.description: If set, this value is used for the Model characteristic instead of querying the projector at startup.

staticSerial.title: Static Serial (optional)
staticSerial.description: If set, this value is used for the Serial Number characteristic instead of querying the projector at startup.

enablePolling.title: Enable State Polling
enablePolling.description: Periodically polls projector state (power, brightness, identifiers) to keep HomeKit in sync.

pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to poll when enabled. Increase to reduce network traffic.
